applications.name: Ride Block - 3
applications.description: Whenever the Attacker blocks a hit during the Defender's Specials, they gain a non-stacking Bulwark Passive increasing their Block Prof. by 60% for 6 second(s). Well Timed Blocks increase this bonus to 90%.

applications.description: When the Attacker performs a [k=glossary/combo_enders]Combo-Ending Attack[/k], they gain a Juke Charge increasing their Attack Rating by +7%. Max stacks: 10. All Charges are removed when performing the same Combo-Ending Attack twice in a row.
